title: Generator and analyzer crash with IndexOutOfRangeException on a closed generic struct from a referenced assembly
intent: A [MessagePackObject] type with a member of a closed generic value type from a referenced assembly builds cleanly and gets a generated resolver.

functional.text: The source generator does not throw IndexOutOfRangeException (CS8785) for a member whose type is a closed generic value type defined in a referenced assembly.
The compiling assembly gets a generated resolver that includes the affected [MessagePackObject] type.
The MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer does not throw (AD0001) for the same member type.

nonFunctional.text: Generated output for types that were already supported does not change (inferred)
A failure inside the generator or analyzer is reported as a diagnostic the user can see, not only as a build warning.

derivedFrom.note: Derived by the evidence lane from the upstream issue text on 2026-11-13; not Tieto's requirements set.
